select id, operation, operation_type, business_id, detail, success, error_message, trace_id, reqid, request_method, request_uri, request_time, user_agent, ip, creator_name, create_time from cms_operation_log
and ( operation like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or request_uri like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or creator_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or reqid like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
and success = #{success}
order by create_time desc, id desc
